spike_plan.kill_if: Only the single splitOutsideParenthesis change exists upstream (about 23 source lines), so the scope stays one lever and fails K10. Kill unless the seed is reshaped around a larger real subset.
spike_plan.pass_if: Ported change passes the PR tests and the random equivalence check, and sibling work of at least 150 non-blank code lines exists upstream to build the scope on.
steps: Clone symfony/symfony in a throwaway container. Check out the parent of 9977966 on the 7.4 line, and check whether v5.4.54 contains an equivalent splitOutsideParenthesis.
Apply PR #61239's OptionsResolver.php change to the base and run the PR's own test file (139 added lines) to confirm it passes.
Write a small PHP harness that generates random nested type strings and compares the old and new split outputs and error messages on about 10k inputs.
Time the old and new split with hyperfine (fresh process per run) to get the real speedup on this runner.
Search for any sibling OptionsResolver change touching resolve(), lazy options or nested parsing on 5.4 or 7.x. Record what is found and stop if none.

v1.summary: Symfony PR #61239 is real and merged (7.4, 5.9x claim in title, 5.88x in commit), but it changes only splitOutsideParenthesis() in about 23 source lines, so the seed's multi-hotpath scope is unsupported. Killed as K10 (one lever, too small, reference public in history); a reshaped seed would need real sibling PRs of at least 150 code lines.
